About the KC Critical Mass group ride

A monthly parade-style ride through Kansas City on the last Friday. No set route, no leaders, the slowest rider sets the pace and the group masses up when it spreads out. News and the ride calendar live on the Facebook group.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
